INSERT INTO transactions (
            sender_id,
            reciever_id,
            reference,
            type,
            amount,
            currency,
            narration,
            status,
            channel,
            reciever_account_number,
            reciever_account_name,
            reciever_bank,
            meta
        )
        VALUES (
            $1, $2, $3, 'credit', $4, 'NGN', $5, 'success', 'external',
            $6, $7, '9PSB', $8
        )
        ON CONFLICT (reference) DO NOTHING
